newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK unit trusts pull in US$168.31 mln in January.
newsitem.headline: HK unit trusts pull in US$168.31 mln in January.

text.p: Hong Kong's unit trust industry attracted a record high net inflow of US$168.31 million in January, the Hong Kong Investment Funds Association (HKIFA) said in a statement on Monday.
Gross inflow reached US$630.12 million, up 83.8 percent over that in December, it said.
The two sectors receiving most investments were Hong Kong equity funds, pulling in US$137.61 million, and Single Asian countries funds, US$69.36 million, but excluding that for Hong Kong and Japan.
Third-placed European equities pulled in US$44.74 million.
Peter Lord, vice chairman of the HKIFA, attributed the inflow to the rally in "the Hong Kong stock market, especially in the fourth quarter of 1996."
